package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    List<String> names,
    List<Double> scores,
    List<Integer> counts,
    List<Boolean> flags,
    List<String> maybe
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (List<String>) map.get("names"),
            (List<Double>) map.get("scores"),
            (List<Integer>) map.get("counts"),
            (List<Boolean>) map.get("flags"),
            (List<String>) map.get("maybe")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("names", names);
        map.put("scores", scores);
        map.put("counts", counts);
        map.put("flags", flags);
        map.put("maybe", maybe);
        return map;
    }
}
